title: Orsen and the Room
author: Vesper Whitlock
blurb: Vesper Crane, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
